project.name: yikesgaming-site
project.productType: Gaming community website (Big Yikes guild): home page, Valheim server join guide, Valheim Hall of Fame

typography.display: Lilita One, single weight (never bold it); headlines only
typography.body: Nunito 400-900; buttons and labels 800, uppercase, letter-spacing .07em
typography.mono: JetBrains Mono 600, for codes, IPs and commands only
typography.scale: meta 14/20, body 17/26, lead 20/30, title 26/30, hero clamp(2.4rem,5.6vw,3.25rem), poster clamp(2.8rem,7.5vw,5.25rem)

shadows.tactile: no soft drop shadows on UI. Buttons sit on a solid 4px lip (box-shadow: 0 4px 0 <darker edge>) and sink on :active with translateY(4px)
shadows.cards: 2px outline (--line) with a heavier bottom edge (border-bottom-width: 6px)

motion.rule: one orchestrated page-load intro at most; motion otherwise only answers a user action; honour prefers-reduced-motion

preferredPrimitives: .key keycaps, .mono codelines with a copy button (data-copy)
details/summary troubleshooting rows with an icon and a chevron
patterns: where you are (navigation) = the icon sits in a raised yellow coin, or a small coin before a text label; which option is picked (segmented, tabs, chips) = a lit key: solid near-white fill, dark text, its own lip. Never tint+outline, never a side stripe
completed/reached = raised yellow coin + green check badge; next = dashed yellow ring; locked = sunken silhouette + lock
real Discord UI snippets as product imagery (Discord colours only inside the snippet)
Valheim wiki inventory icons for in-game things (assets/valheim)

must: keep Big Yikes yellow #FFCD00 and the charcoal/near-black canvas; keep the logos, Bing and Beti mascots and stickers
one yellow primary action per task area
status always in words, never colour alone
touch targets >= 44px; visible yellow focus ring
works at 390px wide with no horizontal scroll
plain HTML/CSS/JS output that can live in a static page (no React runtime on the live site)
copy in the Big Yikes voice: plain, warm, a little funny, sentence case, no hype
avoid: side-stripe accents on cards, rows or selectors (left border/inset shadow stripes)
tinted fill + coloured outline as a selected state
progress states that look 'selected' rather than completed
pill badges, soft grey drop shadows, gradient washes, glassmorphism
generic shadcn/SaaS card grids, numbered 01/02/03 markers on non-sequences, tracked uppercase eyebrows above every heading
indigo/violet accents, cream backgrounds, serif display type
decorative motion on scroll; fade-up on every section

decisions.decision: Design system v4 'tactile': Duolingo product UI owns the component language; Discord lends headline scale and product snippets
v4.5 palette: near-black canvas #090908 and neutral enamel; the old greys read washed out

evidence.fact: reference lock, decision ledger, ship checks
